statement: Finite generation for the $`K(n)`$-local sphere. Answers the degreewise finiteness question of Hovey and Hovey–Strickland: every homotopy group of the $`K(n)`$-local sphere is a finitely generated ℤp-module, for every prime, positive height and integer degree. The same conclusion holds after $`K(n)`$-localizing any finite p-local spectrum.
